text:
maya: Quick check-in for the 4/8 Optimize webinar social plan. Need: 1) X teaser + 1-thread promo + live-thread moderation plan, 2) LinkedIn single post + carousel variant, 3) tiny quote card from speaker for paid. Also finalize paid budget split and landing params.

jordan: Creative can do quote card + short GIF. Ask: which quote short line do we want? options: "2-3x 90th-pct speedups" or "slash latency, not quality".

sam: prefer the straightforward stat for paid (first option) and the second as organic copy test.

tess: scheduling Q: we should stagger posts for APAC/NA coverage. Plan: X teaser 4/6 11am PT, LinkedIn carousel 4/7 9am PT, X promo thread 4/8 10:15am PT (start 10:45am), replay post 4/9 2pm PT. Agree?

maya: yes. Add a second X promo at 4/8 6pm PT targeted for EMEA with localized copy.

jordan: paid budget: $1k total. split 60/40 NA/EMEA. A/B creative: stat card vs. speaker quote. A/B CTA: Demo vs Watch. Landing pages will use utm_campaign=optimize_apr08 & variant=A/B.

matt_sdr: Routing: put all webinar signups into form that writes utm_variant, landing_id, and lead_score. Route lead_score > 50 to Enterprise queue for same-day follow, else Growth queue within 2 hours. I'll set up a filter for utm_variant so we can tie paid performance to pipeline.

maya: fields: name, email, company, title, company_size (dropdown), opt_in_news (checkbox). Keep it breezy.

sam: measurement: short link via go.redwood/opt-apr08 so we can track clicks server-side then redirect to full blog. Include ?utm_source=social&utm_medium=organic&utm_campaign=optimize_apr08&utm_content={{ad_variant}}

jordan: tagging: influencers list -> @aiops_chris, @ml_ops_jen (ask them to RT day-of). Maya pls DM and share speaker bullet points so they have context.

tess: live-thread mod: maya covers first 45m, sam picks up next hour, then matt_sdr monitors lead DMs and tags #lead-follow for high-intent.

jordan: creative checklist: GIF (loop, 3s), stat card (1200x675), speaker quote card (800x800), LinkedIn carousel (3 slides, slides: hook, what-you-ll-learn, CTA + spreadsheet link).

maya: speaker quote (short): "We cut 90th-pct latency by 2-3x without sacrificing output quality." Use it for paid creative.

sam: copy drafts below. Short X (90 char): "2-3x faster 90th-pct inference with Redwood Optimize. Join 4/8 to see how  https://go.redwood/opt-apr08"

Long LinkedIn: "Latency is a first-class constraint for production LLMs. In our benchmarks Redwood Optimize delivered 2-3x improvement at the 90th percentile across real workloads. We'll walk through the config, kernel choices, and cost tradeoffs on 4/8. Register & get the spreadsheet: https://redwood.example.com/blog/optimize-benchmarks-apr08?utm_source=linkedin&utm_campaign=optimize_apr08"

jordan: social_scheduler_bot can you reserve the slots and attach reminder for creative by 4/4 EOD? Also schedule paid ramp start 4/8 9:30am PT.

social_scheduler_bot: Slots reserved. Drafts queued for 2026-04-06 -> 2026-04-09. Creative attach reminder set for 2026-04-04 17:00 PT. Paid campaign scheduled to ramp at 2026-04-08 09:30am PT. :robot_face:

matt_sdr: I'll run a signup test once the go.redwood short link and form are live. Ping me when redirects are live and I will test UTMs and routing.

maya: action items: jordan finalize paid creative + budget distribution, sam publish short links and confirm tracking, tess finalize EMEA copy variant, matt_sdr configure routing + test. We'll reconvene tomorrow EOD if any blockers. :thumbsup:
